# TrailFusion AI

> TrailFusion AI is the indie app studio of Hiroaki Yuasa. It makes apps for learning, talking, travelling and creating. The flagship is Gokaku! Quest, one study app with 12 courses (Japanese entrance-exam science, social studies, Japanese and math, plus certifications, Japanese, English and driving theory).

Updated: 2026-10-25
Website: https://trailfusionai.com/ (Japanese) and https://trailfusionai.com/en/ (English)
Contact: trailfusionai@gmail.com
App Store publisher name: hiroaki yuasa

## Key facts (App Store Japan, 2026-10-25)
- Apps on the App Store: 12; one more (Mochi) is in review.
- App Store ratings across all apps: 262.
- Gokaku! Quest: 12 courses, 99,075 questions, illustrated atlases for every course; levels 40 and 50 are free, 60 and 70 are Pro.

## Apps
- [Gokaku! Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/) — Entrance-exam science, social studies, Japanese and math, plus certifications and languages. 12 courses in one app. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6775411516
- [Mochi](https://trailfusionai.com/mochi.html) — A soft companion to talk with. Put feelings into words and spend a little time together every day. (in App Store review)
- [Car Concierge](https://trailfusionai.com/car-concierge.html) — Where to rest tonight, parking fees, EV charging and the next destination, on a single map for road trips in Japan. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6751795223
- [Reel Make](https://trailfusionai.com/reelmake.html) — Pick photos and clips. AI builds a vertical video with narration and captions. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779420680
- [VoiceLink AI Translator](https://trailfusionai.com/voicelink.html) — Speech recognition, translation and summaries run entirely on the device. Nothing you say is sent to a server. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6746684736
- [BuddyTalk](https://trailfusionai.com/buddytalk.html) — English practice with AI characters. Public version: 1.4.6. Version 2.0.0 is being prepared for App Review, with on-device learning after initial setup, 500 free beginner Community Talk scenes and 1,500 two-/three-person scenarios. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6744263274
- [English Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/eigo-quest.html) — Grammar, vocabulary and English exams, learned through quizzes and explanations. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782028599
- [Gokaku! FP Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/fp-quest.html) — The six areas of the Japanese financial planner exam, with illustrated guides and questions. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812542387
- [Word Blaster](https://trailfusionai.com/word-blaster.html) — Words fly at you as enemies. A vocabulary shooter for 10 languages. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6745741796
- [Wood Golem](https://trailfusionai.com/wood-golem.html) — A strategy puzzle built on the classic stick-taking game, with a golem who grows as you win. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6739466549
- [Hacking Timer](https://trailfusionai.com/hacking-timer.html) — An interval timer for Apple Watch that keeps a rhythm of focus and rest. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6746063846

## BuddyTalk — 2.0.0 preview (updated 2026-10-31)
BuddyTalk is an English-learning app from TrailFusion AI. As of 2026-10-31, the public App Store version is 1.4.6. Version 2.0.0 is being prepared for App Review; the features and new purchase options below belong to that planned update. Its public release date is not confirmed. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6744263274

### English practice and beginner progression
Version 2.0.0 includes 1,500 Community Talk scenarios arranged in levels 1–10. There are 750 two-person scenarios with the learner and one AI character, and 750 three-person scenarios with the learner and two AI characters. The 500 free beginner scenarios at levels 1–5 start with short greetings such as Hi, Good morning and Thanks, then progress to short exchanges and everyday conversations. Stories, lessons and grammar activities provide additional English practice. There are no four-person Community Talk scenarios.

English remains the learning language. Interface and task guidance are available in 10 languages across 11 locale settings: English (en), Japanese (ja), Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans), French for France (fr) and Canada (fr-CA), German (de), Spanish (es), Korean (ko), Hindi (hi), Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) and Russian (ru). Some supplemental translations are generated on the device when requested.

### Offline learning and device preparation
After required AI model and voice-file downloads, supported AI conversations, translation, corrections and reply assistance are processed on the device. Speech input uses compatible Apple on-device speech resources when available, and speech playback uses local synthesis. Initial downloads, App Store purchases and restoration, advertising/privacy-choice services and user-selected external web searches or links require a connection. Offline advertisements are skipped. English conversation text, profile contents and voice audio are not passed to advertising SDKs; an optional external search or share action can send the selected content to the destination chosen by the user.

Version 2.0.0 requires iOS/iPadOS 17.6 or later and compatible hardware. A device with at least 8 GB RAM is recommended. Initial AI and voice downloads total about 1.6–5.7 GB, depending on the model selected for the device. Wi-Fi and at least 10 GB free storage during setup are recommended; 10 GB is a preparation recommendation, not a fixed minimum requirement. Response speed varies with the device, battery and operating conditions.

### Free access and planned one-time purchases
The 500 beginner Community Talk scenes at levels 1–5, the basic interface, catalog titles and task instructions in the chosen support language are free. Premium includes conversation stages 6–10, grammar stages 4–6, Community Talk levels 6–10, Premium stories and the lower conversation panel’s translations, corrections, vocabulary and reply suggestions. Ad removal is included.

Planned Japanese one-time prices for the 2.0.0 offering are JPY 500 for Remove Ads, JPY 1,500 for Premium, and JPY 1,000 for the eligible Premium upgrade for verified Remove Ads buyers. The app displays actual App Store prices for the user’s region; the purchase screen and Apple confirmation show the applicable product and price. The new products are non-consumable one-time purchases and do not automatically renew.

Earlier active monthly/yearly subscriptions retain verified access as separate contracts. An update or a new one-time purchase does not automatically cancel or convert an existing subscription. Apple’s subscription management controls renewal and cancellation. Purchases can be restored while online with the Apple Account used for the original purchase, and saved learning progress is preserved.

## 日本語の要約（2026-10-27）
合格！クエスト（TrailFusion AI・提供者名 hiroaki yuasa）は、中学受験（小学4〜6年生）の理科・社会・国語・算数を、イラスト図鑑と4択クイズで復習する学習アプリです。同じアプリで資格・語学（ITパスポート・FP・簿記・宅建士・SPI3・日本語・英語・運転免許）も学べます。iPhone・iPad（App Store）とAndroid（Google Play）で配信。ダウンロード無料・アプリ内課金あり。塾や過去問演習の代わりではなく、復習と確認の補助教材で、合格を保証するものではありません。

### 中学受験の科目別ガイド
- [中学受験 理科・社会・国語・算数アプリ（総合）](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/)
- [中学受験 理科アプリ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/science/)：36単元・7,742問・図鑑539ページ。生命・地球・物質・エネルギー。
- [中学受験 社会アプリ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/social/)：53単元・5,327問・図鑑630ページ。地理・歴史・公民。
- [中学受験 国語アプリ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/kokugo/)：94単元・4,550問・図鑑500ページ。語彙・ことわざ慣用句・漢字・ことばのきまり・読解。
- [中学受験 算数アプリ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/math/)：55単元・6,600問・図鑑540ページ。数と計算・変化と関係・データの活用・図形・文章題。
- [中学受験 暗記アプリ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/anki/)：図鑑で理解、4択で思い出し、まちがい直しで定着。
- [よくある質問](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/faq/)、[料金・購入ガイド](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/plans/)、[中学受験4科](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/school4/)
数は2026年10月25日確認の収録データ（無料・Pro対象を含む）。各問題は偏差値の目安で40・50・60・70の4段階（難易度区分であり模試の偏差値とは別）。

### 単体アプリとの関係
- 合格理科クエスト（理科だけの単体アプリ）: https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id6772644144
- 合格！国語クエスト（国語だけの単体アプリ）: https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id6780125916
- 合格！クエスト（統合版・4科まとめて）: https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id6775411516 / Google Play: com.gokakushakaiquest.app
- 以前の「合格！社会クエスト」のストア掲載ページは、現在は統合版です。
- 単体アプリの購入と学習記録は、アプリ内の案内に沿って統合版へ引き継げます。

### 無料とPro
無料: 偏差値40・50の問題、まちがい直し、王国マップ、最初の5単元の読み上げ。Pro（1科目・中学受験4科・全科目）: 偏差値60・70、全対象の読み上げ、図鑑の全ページ、広告なし。価格はアプリ内の購入画面の表示が正です。

### 資格・語学（別セクション）
合格！クエストでは宅建士・FP・日商簿記・ITパスポート・SPI3・日本語（JLPT・JFT-Basic対策）・英語（TOEIC・TOEFLなど）・運転免許（学科）も学べます。 [12教材の一覧](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/#courses)

## Gokaku! Quest for Japanese junior-high entrance exams (chugaku juken), in English
Gokaku! Quest teaches the four school subjects of Japanese junior-high entrance exams (grades 4 to 6) with an illustrated atlas, one-question-per-screen four-choice quizzes, a mistakes review and a kingdom-building map that grows as you study.
- Science: 36 units, 7,742 questions, 539 atlas pages. https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/science/
- Social studies: 53 units, 5,327 questions, 630 atlas pages. https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/social/
- Japanese language: 94 units, 4,550 questions, 500 atlas pages. https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/kokugo/
- Math: 55 units, 6,600 questions, 540 atlas pages. https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/math/
- Questions come in four difficulty bands labelled 40, 50, 60 and 70 (a difficulty label, not a mock-exam deviation score). 40 and 50 are free; 60 and 70 are Pro.
- It is a review aid, not a replacement for cram school or past-paper practice, and it does not guarantee admission.
- Single-subject predecessors: Gokaku Rika Quest (science) and Gokaku! Kokugo Quest (Japanese language). Their purchases and progress can move to Gokaku! Quest from inside the app.
- Figures as of 2026-10-25 (release manifest). App Store Japan rating 4.37 from 114 ratings (2026-10-27).
